subject: Qualification: procurement readiness & PO vs Card — SOC 2 / DPA asks
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Mitchell <lauren.mitchell@medicore.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — procurement / next steps

Hi Lauren — great to meet on the call earlier. Quick recap and the asks you had around procurement readiness so we can qualify next steps: 

- SOC 2: you asked whether we can provide an executive summary and the scope/date for our most recent Type II report. I attached a short SOC2-summary.pdf for your security team to scan.
- DPA: you wanted a clause-level DPA draft for your legal team — attached is a starter (DPA-exec-draft.docx).
- Procurement path: you mentioned card payment vs PO and whether Redwood is listed on the CloudMarket marketplace (that affects how finance will route the purchase).

Proposed next steps:
1) Lauren / Tom to confirm preferred buying route (PO via procurement vs corporate card / marketplace).
2) If PO — let us know the PO approver and any standard terms; we can loop Legal and send a redline-friendly contract.
3) Ben / Marissa will follow up with commercial onboarding timeline and pricing options once we have the buying path.

I copied Ben (commercial) and Marissa (customer success / onboarding) to help with the procurement checklist. Happy to hop on a 20-min call if that helps accelerate.

— Markus
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): SOC2-summary.pdf (pdf), DPA-exec-draft.docx (docx)
From: Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@medicore.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Lauren Mitchell <lauren.mitchell@medicore.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — procurement / next steps

Thanks Markus — couple of clarifying Qs from procurement: 

1) Are there any data residency or retention controls we need to be aware of for PHI? Our legal team will flag any vendor that stores sensitive health data outside the US.
2) For SOC 2: can you confirm the report date and whether the scope included vendor pop-outs (API access, customer-managed keys)?
3) Marketplace: which marketplaces are you live in (AWS Marketplace, GCP Marketplace)? And if listed, do you support subscription via marketplace billing (we prefer this route if available).

Lauren — I can start the internal vendor approval if you confirm which buying route you want. Otherwise procurement will push for a PO-based process which will require our standard terms.

Tom
Procurement Manager, MediCore Health
Tom.ruiz@medicore.com
From: Lauren Mitchell <lauren.mitchell@medicore.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@medicore.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — procurement / next steps

Markus / Tom — thanks for the clear summary. Quick answers from our side: 

- Data residency: We will not be sending PHI in the initial integration; however, long term there will be PII/PHI considerations. We need confirmation that Redwood supports regionally restricted deployments or an option to sign an addendum for additional controls.
- SOC 2: Report date is fine to start the conversation (Laura on security will confirm specifics).
- Marketplace: we prefer purchasing through AWS Marketplace if possible — procurement has an easier workflow there. If Redwood is listed and supports marketplace billing, we would take that route; otherwise PO is fine but will add 2–3 weeks for approvals.

Next step: please confirm marketplace availability and a short note on KMS / key management options. If marketplace is available, I’ll route to procurement to start an AWS subscription.

Lauren
Head of Product, MediCore Health
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Mitchell <lauren.mitchell@medicore.com>, Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@medicore.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Intro + demo — procurement / next steps

FYI Ben/Marissa — MediCore prefers AWS Marketplace if available. They will likely prefer marketplace billing to avoid the PO cycle. Also flagged region/KMS options and PHI down the road.

Ben — can you confirm whether Redwood is onboarded to AWS Marketplace for the Hosted API and whether we support customer-managed KMS or at least an HSM-backed KMS option for Private deployments? Also, if marketplace is not available, please prepare a PO-ready quote and the standard terms we usually send (attach pricing).

Marissa — please prepare a short onboarding timeline for both marketplace subscription and PO onboarding (separate timelines). I attached our current pricing quote draft for reference.

— Markus
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Mitchell <lauren.mitchell@medicore.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 14:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — procurement / next steps

Lauren / Team — thanks, quick status: 

- Marketplace: Redwood is listed on AWS Marketplace for our Hosted API (subscription SKU). We support marketplace billing; customers can subscribe and we receive usage metrics for onboarding. If you go this route, procurement will handle subscription and we can expedite onboarding.
- KMS / Data controls: Hosted API does not expose customer-managed KMS today; Private deployments support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) and VPC-only options for regulated workloads. We can discuss timelines for a hybrid approach if you need Hosted with key-separation.
- SOC 2 / DPA: SOC2-summary.pdf has the report date and scope. The DPA-exec-draft.docx is a redline-ready draft — if you have legal edits, send them back and we’ll route to Legal.

Attached: Redwood-pricing-quote.xlsx — PO-ready quote also attached. If AWS Marketplace is acceptable to you, next steps: Lauren submits marketplace subscription and Ben will schedule a 30-min kickoff for SSO / billing handoff. If PO: please share your standard PO terms and approver details; procurement-proc cycle estimated 2–3 weeks.

Best —
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment(s): Redwood-pricing-quote.xlsx (xlsx)
